name: French Payslip, Invoice & Tax Notice
description: French bulletin de paie, facture and avis d'impôt. Detects the NIR (numéro de sécurité sociale), SIRET, SIREN, French VAT number (TVA FR), numéro fiscal, tax notice reference, employee number, IBAN, French dates, phones, street addresses and postal code + city, plus names and emails. Amounts stay visible on purpose.

patterns.name: NIR
patterns.description: Numéro de sécurité sociale: 13 digits plus the 2-digit key, with or without spaces (Corsica 2A/2B included)

patterns.name: SIREN
patterns.description: Company number: 9 digits (123 456 789), only when it is not part of a longer number

patterns.name: TVA FR
patterns.description: French intra-EU VAT number: FR + 2-character key + SIREN

patterns.name: Numéro fiscal
patterns.description: Tax ID on the avis d'impôt: 13 digits starting with 0-3

patterns.name: Réf. avis
patterns.description: Tax notice reference, anchored on the 'Référence de l'avis' label

patterns.name: Matricule
patterns.description: Employee number on a payslip, anchored on the 'Matricule' label

patterns.name: IBAN
patterns.description: International Bank Account Number, with or without spaces between groups

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: French dates: JJ/MM/AAAA, JJ.MM.AAAA or JJ-MM-AAAA

patterns.name: Adresse
patterns.description: Street address: number + street type + street name (rue, avenue, boulevard, impasse…)

patterns.name: Code postal
patterns.description: Postal code + city, e.g. 75011 Paris, 69003 LYON, 75009 PARIS CEDEX 09
